sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The leaders are in outstanding form, having won their last match and strung together five consecutive wins before that. Alsager, bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games, arrive on a dire run and represent a fixture Sandbach will be heavily favoured to win.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match that could see them cut the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong sides—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six despite a recent defeat, while Eccleshall are inconsistent but capable. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, visit Wednesfield Community in a local derby that carries some importance for both teams' playoff aspirations. Bilston Town, sitting sixth, travel to Foley Meir hoping to maintain their recent winning form. Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a mid-table affair; Shawbury are struggling badly with five losses in their last six games. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in another lower-table battle, with both sides fighting to climb away from the relegation zone. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home—Crewe are winless in their last three matches and near the bottom, while Allscott Heath have shown brief signs of recovery. Cheadle Heath Nomads, in the bottom half, travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers. Brereton Social, at home to Widnes Town, face the league's only pointless club—Widnes have managed just two draws in seven games and sit rock-bottom.
